a.xlink:title: Solves a source with default options using the external SMT solver CLI and returns a collected result per ``check-sat`` command, in script order, after cleanup. Valid sources are ``object(Object)``, ``terms(Statements)``, ``codes(Codes)``, and ``file(Path)``.

Solves a source using ``solver/1``, ``executable/1``, and ``time_limit/1`` options. Repeated options use the first occurrence. Valid sources are ``object(Object)``, ``terms(Statements)``, ``codes(Codes)``, and ``file(Path)``.
Generates and prints SMT-LIB 2 source to the current output, equivalent to ``program/2`` followed by ``print_program/1``, without invoking the solver.
Returns SMT-LIB 2 source codes from ``object(Object)``, ``terms(Statements)``, ``codes(Codes)``, or ``file(Path)`` without invoking the solver.
Prints SMT-LIB 2 character codes to the current output without adding a newline or invoking the solver.
Returns the collected status (``satisfiable``, ``unsatisfiable``, or ``unknown``) of a single ``check-sat`` result.
Enumerates, by backtracking, the collected model bindings (``Symbol-Value`` pairs) without starting a process. Fails when the result has no model.
Looks up the collected model value bound to ``Symbol``. Fails when the result has no model or no binding for ``Symbol``.
Enumerates, by backtracking, the named assertions in the collected unsatisfiable core without starting a process. Fails when the result has no core.
Enumerates, by backtracking, ``status(Status)`` and the stored result properties.
Prints a single collected result (status and, when present, model bindings and unsat core names) to the current output, without invoking the solver.
Prints each collected result in ``Results``, in order, separating consecutive results with a blank line.

Enumerates, by backtracking, advisory ``Solver``-``Feature`` capability pairs. Purely informational: the library does not enforce these pairs and a solver call may still succeed, fail, or report ``unknown`` for a feature outside this table.
